title: Take the Loose Rook
setup: Two rooks face each other on the **a-file** — and Black's king is also on the back rank.
hint: Check which of the two rooks on the a-file has a defender.
explanation:
## The Idea

The black rook on a8 has no defender: the king on e8 is four squares away. {{Rxa8+}} takes it with check, the king must step off the back rank, and you are left with king and rook against a bare king, a forced win.

Your rook on a2 was just as loose, so with Black to move it would have fallen instead. When two loose pieces face each other, whoever moves first wins.
